_readme: Reasonix owns this request method, tool and capability vocabulary, and the fields of its transcript tool record. LeapMux owns the envelope key around that record. The worker routes the request and the browser draws its form from the same method identifier.

Ask.why: the browser spells `Yolo` alone, for the bypass preset it builds; Reasonix itself labels the three choices on the option group the worker forwards, so no browser code words this one
